title: Mileage and Fuel Schedule for Courtesy Transportation Agreements
content:
Check-in lane reference for Courtesy Transportation Agreements: the mileage and fuel figures of each program. Fuel is measured in eighths of a tank; amounts are in US dollars.

## Mileage

| Program | Miles included per charged or courtesy day | Free buffer miles above the allowance | Charge per mile above the allowance and buffer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 75 | 25 | 0.35 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 100 | 25 | 0.35 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 100 | 25 | 0.40 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 100 | 25 | 0.50 |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 100 | 25 | 0.40 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 150 | 25 | 0.45 |

- **Miles included per day** are the miles per charged or courtesy day included free.
- **Free buffer** is the miles above the allowance that are not charged.
- **Charge per mile** applies to each mile above the allowance and the buffer.

## Fuel

| Program | Least fuel level at issue (eighths) | Same level in tank terms | Charge per eighth returned below the issue level | Flat refueling service fee when a fuel charge applies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 4 | half a tank | 7.50 | 10.00 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 6 | three quarters of a tank | 7.50 | 10.00 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 6 | three quarters of a tank | 8.75 | 10.00 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 6 | three quarters of a tank | 11.25 | 10.00 |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 6 | three quarters of a tank | 8.75 | 10.00 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 8 | a full tank | 11.25 | 0.00 |

- **Least fuel level at issue** is the lowest fuel level, in eighths of a tank, at which the program's loaner is issued.
- **Charge per eighth** applies to each eighth of a tank the loaner is returned below the level it was issued at.
- **Refueling service fee** is a flat fee added when a fuel charge applies. The Fleet Replacement Unit fee is 0.00, so a fleet fuel charge consists of the per-eighth amount alone.

## Hypothetical fuel figures

The fuel levels below are invented for illustration; the rates are the schedule's.

| Program | Issued at | Returned at | Eighths short | Per-eighth amount | Service fee | Fuel total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 7 eighths | 5 eighths | 2 | 17.50 | 10.00 | 27.50 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 6 eighths | 3 eighths | 3 | 33.75 | 10.00 | 43.75 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 8 eighths | 6 eighths | 2 | 22.50 | 0.00 | 22.50 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 6 eighths | 6 eighths | 0 | none | none | no fuel charge |
